airzone_health.help: Alerts follow the data received by Moli. Hidden devices remain monitored. No message is sent to your phone.
airzone_health.none_reported: No active alert reported by devices with available diagnostics.
airzone_health.not_reported: Diagnostics have not been reported yet.
airzone_health.coverage: Diagnostics are missing or cannot be refreshed for {count} device(s). This does not establish that everything is working.
airzone_health.help.connection: Alerts and readings can no longer be refreshed.
airzone_health.help.driver: Check the gateway and driver status in Installation. The last readings may not reflect the current state.
airzone_health.help.offline: The device is no longer reported as available. Check its power and connection to Airzone.
airzone_health.help.low_battery: The thermostat reports a low battery. Consult its manual to replace the batteries.
airzone_health.help.device_error: Check the displayed code and your Airzone installation documentation.
airzone_health.help.device_warning: Check the zone state and the warning reported by the system.
airzone_health.help.unknown_alarm: The received diagnostic cannot be fully interpreted. Check the parameters and the Airzone app.
airzone_health.help.problem: Airzone reports a problem without a complete usable diagnostic.
airzone_health.battery_help: The level is shown only when reported. The low-battery alert comes from the thermostat, with no additional Moli threshold.
airzone_health.check.title: Check the Airzone connection
airzone_health.check.presence.present: This zone appears in the latest response from the gateway.
airzone_health.check.presence.absent: This zone is absent from the latest complete response from the gateway.
airzone_health.check.presence.unknown: The response cannot establish whether this zone is present.
airzone_health.check.presence.gateway: The connection responds. This device cannot be checked as an individual zone.
airzone_health.check.next.absent: Compare the zones shown on the thermostat and in the Airzone app. If this zone is also missing there, check its power, connection and pairing with your installer, without resetting the installation.
airzone_health.check.next.present: The gateway lists this zone. Compare its status on the thermostat or in the Airzone app, then wait for Moli’s next automatic reading.
airzone_health.check.next.battery: The low-battery warning comes from the thermostat. Follow its manual to replace the batteries, then check its status in the Airzone app.
airzone_health.check.next.unknown: Compare with the thermostat or the Airzone app. Gateway technical information is available in Installation; this result does not establish that the zone is absent.
airzone_health.check.next.compare: Compare the report with the thermostat and the Airzone app. For a fault code, consult your installation manual or installer.
airzone_health.check.retained: This check does not change any device. The alert will update when automatic polling confirms the new state.
airzone_health.check.errors.auth: Confirm your Moli code, then run the check again.
airzone_health.check.errors.auth_busy: Another action is waiting for your Moli code. Finish it before checking.
airzone_health.check.errors.busy: The gateway is already handling a read. Wait a few seconds before trying again.
airzone_health.check.errors.missing: This gateway is no longer registered. Open Installation.
airzone_health.check.errors.invalid: The read could not be validated. Open Installation.
airzone_health.check.errors.failed: The gateway did not provide a usable response. Check its connection in Installation.
airzone_health.check.errors.network: The check did not complete. Check the connection to Moli and the gateway.
airzone_health.check.errors.timeout: The check timed out. Check the gateway connection before trying again.
airzone_health.wired_help: Battery and radio coverage do not apply to a wired connection.
airzone_health.metadata_missing: Information not supplied by the Local API
airzone_health.metadata_help: This zone does not report its thermostat connection type, battery or radio signal to Moli. This does not mean that its batteries are empty or its connection is weak. Compare this information in the Airzone app or on the thermostat.
